dedupe_keys.name: onshore wind turbine model reference library rotor diameter rated power hub height and power curve parameters

description: This data set is a reference table of 762 onshore wind turbine models giving, for each, the rotor diameter, rated power, hub height and the cut-in, rated and cut-out wind speeds of the power curve. It was published on Zenodo in 2026 by Chen Dong, and was assembled for remote sensing work in which a rotor diameter measured from imagery is matched to a plausible turbine model, so it also works as a general lookup from diameter to capacity. Every row states its provenance: 60 named commercial models come from manufacturer specification sheets, 15 from product announcements and 488 from a public online turbine catalogue, while 199 are synthetic placeholders created to keep the diameter-capacity grid continuous and are labelled as not real products. A further column names, per row, which values were estimated by rule, not sourced. Coverage is global commercial onshore turbines. The table is downloadable from Zenodo (version 1.0.0) under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the synthetic rows must be filtered out for anything but nearest-neighbour lookup, and the online catalogue is not named in the abstract. Simulation uses are estimating wind fleet capacity and exposure from imagery and parameterising turbine power curves. Related records: data-south-africa-wind-turbines and data-ea-owt-east-asia-offshore-wind-turbines are turbine inventories.
